tools.name: issue_authorization_record
tools.description: Use this tool before an AI agent initiates a payment, paid API call, checkout action, stablecoin transfer, x402 request, or delegated commercial transaction. It verifies agent authority, checks scope, issues a signed verification record, and returns evidence for dispute review and Trust Graph update

tools.name: verify_agent_authority
tools.description: Use this tool when a merchant or API seller receives a signed verification record from an agent. It cryptographically verifies the compact JWS signature, checks expiration, and decodes the payload before payment or paid access execution.

tools.name: lookup_agent_reputation
tools.description: Use this tool to query the FLINT Trust Graph for a partner-scoped agent's historical reputation before permitting a payment, paid API call, checkout action, x402 request, or delegated commercial transaction. It returns aggregate reputation without exposing raw runtime identifiers or internal signal

tools.name: submit_transaction_outcome

tools.name: generate_authorization_scope
tools.description: Use this tool when an agent commerce workflow needs a well-formed delegated authorization scope before issuing a signed verification record. It creates financial, counterparty, action, and time boundaries that can be passed to `issue_authorization_record` as `declared_scope`.

tools.description: Use this tool when reviewing a commerce architecture, API marketplace, paid MCP tool, x402 endpoint, or autonomous checkout flow. tools.name: get_agent_passport
tools.description: Use this tool to resolve a public FLINT Agent Passport by passport_id. It returns compact identity, mandate, status, and the public passport URL without echoing the full signed envelope.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "generate_authorization_scope" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agent_passport · Private data: issue_authorization_record, verify_agent_authority, create_flint_trust_manifest, generate_authorization_scope, validate_agent_commerce_readiness, issue_agent_passport, update_agent_mandate · Public sink: submit_transaction_outcome.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agent_passport · Private data: issue_authorization_record, verify_agent_authority, create_flint_trust_manifest, generate_authorization_scope, validate_agent_commerce_readiness, issue_agent_passport, update_agent_mandate · Public sink: submit_transaction_outcome

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
